description: YouTube Data API v3 integration and video transcript extraction for video metadata, comment threads, channel analytics, channel uploads playlist retrieval, keyword video search, and transcripts.

auth.instructions: Create an API key in Google Cloud Console with YouTube Data API v3 enabled, then paste it here.

required_secrets.name: youtube_api_key
required_secrets.prompt: YouTube Data API Key (from Google Cloud Console, starts with 'AIzaSy...'), guide: https://developers.google.com/youtube/v3/getting-started?hl=en, plz set API type to Public data
